text:
Situation: Fluoxetine hydrochloride 20 mg capsules are low at both campuses. Corvale East has 90 capsules, 10.4 days on hand at 8.7 used per day. Corvale General has 221 capsules, 28.1 days on hand at 7.9 used per day. No national shortage is declared.

Why (FDA record): FDA's records show fluoxetine hydrochloride is not on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Supply is adequate at Corvale General but critical at Corvale East. All identified manufacturers are not on FDA's shortage list today. None of their labels name a plant we could place. Procurement can proceed without shortage-driven allocation limits.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer places an immediate order with Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc. for Corvale East; buyer approves.
2. Buyer places a supplemental order with Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited for Corvale East; buyer approves.
3. Buyer places an order with Aurobindo Pharma Limited for Corvale General to maintain buffer; buyer approves.
4. Buyer qualifies BluePoint Laboratories and Cadila Pharmaceuticals Limited as backup sources; buyer and P&T chair approve.
5. Inventory manager tracks daily use at both sites and reports to P&T weekly; inventory manager approves.

Not recommended: Do not initiate therapeutic interchange or dose changes based on this supply status. Do not delay ordering while awaiting committee vote on formulary changes.
